annotation.title_clean: Projeto de Lei n. 349/2024 - Institui campanha de prevenção e combate aos crimes digitais contra crianças, adolescentes e pessoas com deficiência praticados com o suporte de ferramentas de inteligência artificial
annotation.title_en: Bill No. 349/2024 - Establishes a campaign to prevent and combat digital crimes against children, adolescents and persons with disabilities committed with the support of artificial intelligence tools
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Câmara dos Deputados (Dep. Maria Rosas, Republicanos/SP)
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian bill (PL 349/2024) creating a public awareness and prevention campaign against AI-enabled digital crimes, such as deepfake child sexual content, targeting children, adolescents and persons with disabilities. It funds the campaign through the Diffuse Rights Fund and amends the Child and Adolescent Statute and the Persons with Disabilities Statute.
key_provisions_or_claims: Establishes a national campaign against AI-enabled digital crimes targeting children, adolescents and persons with disabilities.
Trains educators to identify unlawful conduct involving AI misuse.
Funding from the Diffuse Rights Fund, the federal budget and donations.
Amends ECA art. 70-A and adds art. 92-A to the Statute of Persons with Disabilities.
Campaign planning and oversight left to later regulation.
